content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring), which the payer states was denied because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I34.0 and R00.2. Per the indication note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities. We therefore request review of the missing authorization and payment of the outstanding balance of 599.38 for this medically necessary service."}
